references.text: The Lord promises to send His terror before Israel and drive out the enemies little by little, which is the same promise about driving out enemies mentioned in Deuteronomy 6:19.
God promises to drive out the enemies from the land, which is the same promise given in Deuteronomy 6:19.
Israel is told to drive out all the inhabitants of the land, reflecting the promise in Deuteronomy 6:19 about driving out the enemies.
The Lord promises to go before Israel and destroy the enemies, as He had promised, referring to the same promise in Deuteronomy 6:19.
Joshua reminds the people that the Lord has driven out nations before them, which is the fulfillment of the promise in Deuteronomy 6:19.
The Lord has driven out great and mighty nations before Israel, in accordance with the promise given in Deuteronomy 6:19.
